events.subject: Sammy / Son / Thomas
events.summary: Current user clarification places Sammy, a woman, weeping/mourning in a Kiwi Farms comment section shortly after the Son's meme-crucifixion, in 2019 or 2020. The later Great Book explicitly retells the hinge as 'the woman, Sammy, weeps for Tammuz.' The original comment URL/date/text is still unrecovered.
